Irina K.: quick sync — after bringing up the multimodal candidate (open-vision-x), we need to augment the golden promptset with image+prompt edgecases. priority is preventing regressions when we roll quantized variants.
Sam B.: SGTM. can we start by de-duping the existing multimodal corpus? noticed a lot of alt-text duplicates and near-duplicates from crawls.
Maria L.: agree — also we should version the labeling schema to v2: annotate object-level correctness + hallucination flag + OCR-confidence. i'll drop the spec in the doc.
Sam B.: for de-dupe i ran a quick pass using perceptual-hash + normalized prompt sha. snippet:```python
# dedupe multimodal dataset
from PIL import Image
import imagehash, hashlib, json

def normalize(text):
    return ' '.join(text.lower().strip().split())

with open('candidates.json') as f:
    for rec in json.load(f):
        rec['img_hash'] = str(imagehash.phash(Image.open(rec['img_path'])))
        rec['text_hash'] = hashlib.sha256(normalize(rec.get('caption','')).encode()).hexdigest()
# then group by (img_hash, text_hash) and keep most recent/highest-quality
```
Sam B.: leaving the dedupe threshold at hamming<=4 for now. thoughts? :eyes:
Maria L.: hamming<=4 seems fine for phash, but please keep a random sample of removed items for audit. we had false merges before with small crops. add sample size 500.
Ashok P.: also flag examples where the model changes answer under quantization — i.e., full-precision says 'no object', int8 says 'object present'. we'll need an automated regression detector tied to the eval harness. i can add a hook that runs the FP and Q8 variants and diffs outputs + OCR tokens.
Julia C.: timeline: can we have dedupe + schema update + labeler onboarding by end of next week? we need to freeze the golden set before the canary roll.
Irina K.: yes, target = next-friday EOD. Maria — will you update the labeling doc and send short training? Sam — can you produce the de-dupe manifest and sampling script by Wed? Ashok — implement regression hook by Thu?
Maria L.: i'll update the doc (Notion link: https://notion.redwood/inference/ml/golden-multimodal-v2) and schedule two 30m labeler calibration sessions. labels will be in label-studio schema v2.
